name: Prototype Puppets

gist.Tri Fecta, the Puppet Master: Starts the game with three Puppet tokens in his support zones. He and the puppets share a single pool of health, and only one puppet may act each turn. With no puppets left he is defeated at once.
gist.Tri Ad, the Puppet Mistress: A hero card in the deck that she lays on top of Tri Fecta (and can lift off again); while she is on top the three puppets turn into three different ones.
gist.Omikron, the Faceless Illusionist: Each turn creates a one-health copy of any creature, with its effect delayed a turn.
gist.Kohta, the Silent Observer: When a small creature of hers kills with its effect, that effect fires a second time.
gist.Haressassin: Fragile creature with a hard shot each turn; Kohta's favourite.
gist.Field Cannon: Very fragile creature with an enormous shot each turn.
gist.Cannon Tower: Sturdy creature with a strong shot each turn.
gist.Aggressive Town Guard: Free summon with a small shot.
gist.Pinaxolotl: When it dies it fetches another creature.
gist.Hell Fox: When it dies it fetches any card.
gist.Scavenging Crane: Arranges the top of her deck and draws.
gist.Create Illusion: Puts a creature from the deck straight onto the board.
gist.Teleportal: Fetches any card for next turn.
gist.Creativity: Ability: draws when she attaches an Ability to that hero.
gist.Inventing: Ability: discard to draw, and at level three to search.
gist.Deepsea Idol: Cancels a sweep on two or more creatures.

plan: A designer's toolbox built around three puppets. One puppet per turn acts: one searches her deck for any card, one makes you choose which of three cards on the board is discarded, one shields her creatures. Laying Tri Ad over Tri Fecta swaps them for a second set: draw four, a free one-health summon, a redirect. So Wren always has the right tool, and uses it to assemble fragile, hard-hitting creatures that Kohta fires twice. The construction is delicate: the puppets and Tri Fecta share one health pool, a puppet removed is gone for good, and when the last one goes Tri Fecta falls with it.

looks.early: Tri Fecta with three puppets at his feet, a Scavenging Crane, cards being searched one per turn.
looks.mid: A Haressassin and a Field Cannon behind the puppets, Tri Ad laid over Tri Fecta and lifted off again.
looks.late: Two puppets left, one-health illusions everywhere, and Wren adjusting something with a pencil.

opening.tell: Tri Fecta and his three puppets share a single pool of health, and each puppet counts as a target.
opening.why: Flame Avalanche and Cataclysm hit every target she controls, and Tri Fecta and each of his three puppets take it out of the same pool, four times over; she, meanwhile, searches a card every turn, so a slow game is hers.

midgame.tell: Each puppet does a different job, and one of them just made you pick which of your cards to lose.
midgame.why: A puppet is a card on the board that is not a hero: The Yeeting removes one permanently, each one gone is a third of her toolbox, and the third takes Tri Fecta with it; her creatures are shielded by the puppet that guards them.

crisis.tell: The puppets have changed faces: Tri Ad is on top, and the creatures arriving through them have a single point of health.
crisis.why: Everything she summons through the second set of puppets, and every illusion from Omikron, dies to any damage at all; one sweep clears the board she has spent the duel assembling.

endgame.tell: One puppet remains under Tri Fecta and her other two heroes are ordinary.
endgame.why: Remove the last puppet and Tri Fecta is defeated on the spot; her other heroes have no protection once the toolbox is gone.

opening.board: Wren's puppets sit under Tri Fecta; one of them searches her deck and she nods to herself.

options.text: Flame Avalanche: hero and three puppets, one pool

opening.board: A Scavenging Crane and a Town Guard; she attaches Inventing and draws off Creativity.

options.text: Cataclysm: the shared pool takes it four times

opening.board: One puppet shows you three cards on the board and you must choose which to lose.

options.text: That puppet goes first: Yeet it
